name: Do I need to seal grout for bathroom tile flooring?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to seal grout for bathroom tile flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, sealing grout for bathroom tile flooring is highly recommended, especially in high-moisture areas like showers or around bathtubs. Grout is naturally porous, meaning it can absorb water, stains, and mildew if left unsealed. A good quality grout sealer creates a protective barrier that repels moisture and makes cleaning easier, preventing discoloration and bacterial growth. The frequency of sealing depends on the type of sealer used and the amount of traffic and moisture the bathroom experiences, typically every 1-3 years.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, sealing bathroom grout is recommended to protect against water, stains, and mildew. It helps maintain cleanliness and prevents damage to porous grout.
